item.title: Snake in the Tree
item.description:
Drink Rating Notes
The First Sin 3 / 5 This drink comes with a peculiar property—a faint magical shimmer that tints the liquid based on the drinker’s moral alignment. B33’s turned a deep amber. Mine remained perfectly clear, which I am told is either reassuring or deeply unsettling depending on who you ask. The flavor is crisp, almost apple-like, with a lingering warmth. Clever, but the gimmick overshadows the craftsmanship.
